cases.label: 구성 시 실행하지 않고 왼쪽부터 각 한 번 호출한다
cases.probe: const log=[]; const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({}); const run=tools.pipe(value=>{log.push(['double',value]); return value*2;},value=>{log.push(['add',value]); return value+1;}); const before=[...log]; const first=run(3); const second=run(4); observe({before,first,second,log});

cases.label: 빈 pipe는 입력을 그대로 돌려준다
cases.probe: const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({}); const input={value:7}; const result=tools.pipe()(input); result.observed='same-input'; observe(input);

cases.label: stage에는 고정 receiver와 값 하나만 전달한다
cases.probe: const log=[]; const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({factor:3}); const run=tools.pipe(function(value){log.push([this.factor,arguments.length]); return value*this.factor;},function(value){log.push([this.factor,arguments.length]); return value+this.factor;}); const result=run.call({factor:99},2); observe({result,log});

cases.label: 부분 적용 인수의 순서와 재사용 상태를 보존한다
cases.probe: const log=[]; const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({tag:'fixed'}); function join(...parts){log.push([this.tag,...parts]); return parts.join('/');} const adapted=tools.partial(join,'A','B'); const before=[...log]; const first=adapted.call({tag:'other'},'C'); const second=adapted('D','E'); observe({before,first,second,log});

cases.label: 커링은 두 번째 인수에서 원함수를 한 번 실행한다
cases.probe: const log=[]; const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({tag:'curried'}); const pair=tools.curry2(function(a,b){log.push([this.tag,a,b,arguments.length]); return a+':'+b;}); const waiting=pair('A'); const before=[...log]; const first=waiting('B'); const second=pair('C')('D'); observe({before,first,second,log});

cases.label: 오류 뒤 단계를 실행하지 않고 같은 던진 값을 전파한다
cases.probe: const log=[]; const thrown={code:'planned'}; const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({}); const run=tools.pipe(value=>{log.push('first'); return value+1;},()=>{log.push('fail'); throw thrown;},()=>{log.push('unexpected'); return 99;}); try {run(1);} catch(error){error.observed='caught';} observe({log,thrown});

cases.label: 다른 도구의 receiver와 부분 인수가 섞이지 않는다
cases.probe: const a=submission.createFunctionalTools({tag:'a'}); const b=submission.createFunctionalTools({tag:'b'}); function format(value){return this.tag+':'+value;} const fromA=a.partial(format); const fromB=b.partial(format); observe([fromA(1),fromB(2),fromA(3)]);

cases.label: 부분 적용과 커링에서도 원래 예외를 보존한다
cases.probe: const tools=submission.createFunctionalTools({}); const first={code:'partial'}; const second={code:'curry'}; try{tools.partial(()=>{throw first;})('x');}catch(error){error.observed='caught';} try{tools.curry2(()=>{throw second;})('x')('y');}catch(error){error.observed='caught';} observe([first,second]);
